title: Selected Work
subtitle: AI agents in production, no-code ERP for SMEs, and SME workflow automation — selected for Xentral

application.pursuit_framing: PATH 2 — complementary Head of AI Product / AI-Experience pitch with explicit disqualification of the Staff/Principal-Engineer IC profile in paragraph 1 of the cover letter
application.positioning: AI-Product Practice in Production · SME / No-Code-ERP Workflow Empathy · Founder-Pace Partnership · Design-Engineering Bridge

selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Primary positioning hook. Ninox is no-code ERP for SMEs (verbatim domain match for Xentral's SME-ERP-automation category — required surfacing per preferences §5). The vibe-coding onboarding is the single best evidence of Tobias's AI-product practice meeting Xentral's exact customer shape: prompt → generated database schema → split-screen direct manipulation + chat. Carries the user-agency principle ('show output, allow users to edit') as the crystallised AI opinion required by preferences §6. Bonus: this is the case study where founder-pace partnership shows up most cleanly (CEO + technical co-founder stealth engagement before the product team was involved). In-depth format because the AI judgment + SME domain + founder-pace story compress badly.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: Direct AI-agent-in-production proof point. A Copilot SKILL shipped at Bibel TV — handbook-as-context (not training data), escalation-as-first-class-output, human-keeps-the-send-decision. This is the closest single artifact in the portfolio to Xentral's 'AI agents to automate mission-critical business processes' brief. Honest scope: it's a platform-built skill, not a custom-orchestrated agent — see Pillar A gaps in the cv-tailoring-brief. The crystallised opinion ('move the blank-page problem, don't touch the judgment') is reusable in cover-letter paragraph 1. In-depth format because the executive variant strips the design decisions that make this case study credible.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: SME workflow automation with measurable outcomes (70% funeral coordination-time reduction, 90% acceptance rate) in a GDPR-plus regulated environment. Reframed scope from 'funeral-booking feature' to 'booking capability deeply integrated into the platform' — strategic-influence proof at the SME-software layer. Dual PM + design role + direct customer collaboration with project leads, pastors, funeral directors — credible cross-functional-partnership signal for Xentral's founder-pace operating model. In-depth format because the scope-reframe narrative + measurable impact + regulated context compress badly.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Builder-mindset and design-engineering-bridge proof. Designed in Figma, then prototyped in real code against real Bibel TV APIs; engineering consumes ~70% of the prototype code directly. The Android-gradient iteration story is the concrete proof point for cover-letter paragraph 2. Direct match for Xentral's 'high-agency builder, validate solutions with real customers' must-have — but framed honestly at the design-engineering-bridge layer, not as Staff-Engineer IC work. Executive format keeps it complementary to the ninox-ai-onboarding + bibeltv-support-agent anchors.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: Closest API-architecture adjacency Tobias has — Git repo + Style Dictionary + automation, three-tier hierarchy (global primitives → semantic → component), Android consuming tokens live, Figma synced via plugin, iOS + web endpoints ready. Per cv-tailoring-brief Pillar E. Surfaces 'designed the design-token API architecture' as the honest framing — NOT distributed systems, NOT Staff-Engineer ERP-platform engineering. Browseable because it is the deepest infrastructure proof in the portfolio, but Xentral's JD asks for production-AI-agent engineering, not design-system-as-API engineering; surfacing it as featured risks miscueing the recruiter.
selection_rationale.ninox-org-building: Hidden — strong leadership story (performance calls, hiring/firing, coaching the design lead, inclusive team norms) but Xentral's JD is engineering-leadership-shaped, not design-team-leadership-shaped. Surfacing org-building as featured would invite the literal-manage-managers question the path-2 pitch already concedes is a gap. Available via ?all for readers who want to verify leadership depth.
selection_rationale.datameer-data-dense-analytics: Hidden — design leadership for a data-pipeline product serving regulated bank/insurance customers is the closest adjacency to Xentral's 'data pipelines' literacy must-have, but the case study is older (2014-2019) and frames at the data-viz layer, not the data-engineering layer. Kept for those who go deep via ?all; the CV references Datameer's 5-year tenure separately as the scale anchor.
selection_rationale.spreadshirt-user-research-strategy: Hidden — strategic-influence proof for those going deep; older (2014-16) and not Xentral-domain-adjacent. ChurchDesk + Ninox are the current strategic-influence anchors.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-app-redesign: Hidden — growth + competitive-strategy angle is good but not Xentral-domain-adjacent. Kept for ?all readers.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Hidden — craft-depth proof but narrowest Xentral fit of the Bibel TV set; risks pulling the recruiter's attention away from the AI-product-practice anchors.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-prototyping: Hidden — substantially overlaps bibeltv-agentic-engineering AND status=in-progress with known AI-slop issues flagged at the n8n review. Avoid surfacing two near-duplicate stories in the Xentral view, and avoid surfacing a story that has not passed the writing quality gate.

gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.staff_principal_engineer_ic_profile: Per cv-tailoring-brief Gap 1 (NO MATCH): the path-2 pitch acknowledges plainly in cover-letter paragraph 1. NO new case study fabricated to paper over this — Xentral's stated AI-screening of applications elevates the cost of fabrication beyond the usual truthfulness gate.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.distributed_systems_backend_architecture: Per cv-tailoring-brief Gap 2 (NO MATCH): bibeltv-design-system-api is the closest real adjacency. The case study is honestly framed as 'designed the token-architecture decisions because no platform-engineering team existed' — NOT 'architected distributed systems'. No additional case study fabricated.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.daily_production_code_commit_cadence: Per cv-tailoring-brief Gap 3 (NO MATCH): bibeltv-agentic-engineering names this honestly — prototype code consumed by engineering, not daily production-backend commits. No additional case study fabricated.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.custom_agent_orchestration_code: Per verification-log Pillar A: Tobias did NOT personally write LLM-orchestration code for the CS Copilot SKILL or the Ninox vibe-coding engine. Both case studies frame the scope honestly. The 'AI fundraising pipeline currently building' is referenced only in the cv-tailoring brief as in-build status — no separate case study, no shipped/deployed framing, no metrics.
